Articles/Software/Version-Control/git.title: git
Articles/Software/Version-Control/git.content:
Rebase
git checkout main 
git pull origin main 
git checkout my_branch 
git rebase main 
git rebase --continue 
# + means force, overwrite changes
git push origin +my_branch 
# If something goes wrong 
git rebase --abort
Stash
Hide all new changes, except new files.
git stash #hide
git stash pop #restore
Add to the last commit
git commit --amend --no-edit
git push origin +my_branch 
Delete the last commit
# delete changes or save in the working dir 
git reset --hard HEAD~1 
git reset --soft HEAD~1 
git push origin --force
Workflow for Quartz
git add . && git commit -m "Update." && git push
